document: Fullstack Developer at Enevo (April 2013 - July 2017). Enevo provides IoT-based waste management solutions. Developed backend APIs in Python and PHP within a microservices architecture. Built React, React Native, and AngularJS clients for web and mobile. Managed MySQL and MongoDB databases for scalable solutions. Delivered small-scale projects and feature enhancements alongside main product.
